beats.line: A small house in Hyderabad. All the happiness in that home... was their only son, Abhinav. Here, dear... curd and sugar. It's your first-salary day... go well, and come back. Amma, this Sunday I want to take you both to Srisailam. It was Tatayya's wish... I'll fulfil it with my salary! Ride slowly. Your Tatayya's rudraksha is on your wrist... take care. Okay, Nanna! I'll be back with sweets this evening!

beats.line: Hello... is this Abhinav's home? I'm calling from City Hospital. Yes... I'm his mother. What happened? Amma, I'm sorry... your son has had an accident. It's serious. Please come right away. Listen...! Our Abhi...!
O Lord... nothing must happen to my child... nothing, Swami...

beats.line: Doctor! BP is falling... I can't find a pulse! Get the defibrillator ready... quickly!

In that fear... Raghava remembered his father's words. Raghava... on the day no medicine works, the day death stands at the door... chant the Mahamrityunjaya mantra. Chant it with faith... and even Yama steps back.

beats.line: Abhi... my dear! You opened your eyes, my child... my life has come back! I heard you saved that little girl... I'm so proud of you. Amma... Nanna... I went somewhere far away... but the power of your mantra brought me back.
Abhinav, your journey does not end here. A great task you must fulfil still remains. A great responsibility that will give your life its true meaning awaits you...
